The '''father''' of [[Eanjer Kunarazti]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] and was the owner of [[Polestar Imports]]. He was killed by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
